statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r = (Rmax - Rmin + 1) * (Cmax - Cmin + 1), where Rmin is the minimum row index i such that some cell (i,j) equals 1, Rmax is the maximum such row index, Cmin is the minimum column index j such that some cell (i,j) equals 1, and Cmax is the maximum such column index.
